browser.scope: Native menus, physical coin pickup, live non-pausing shop, real keyboard and CDP multitouch, scrolling, exact saves, continuous boss entry and ten-minute deadline. Stationary enemies, on-player coin funding and timeline-edge fixtures are explicit QA fixtures. Nine equipment effects on all four weapons are separately exercised in unit simulation tests.
